description: The 41 ready-made lists on yourfinancejob.com/lists, in three groups (where you want to work, the kind of firm, the kind of work), each with today's live count and a link; a list is a named live query that refills itself every morning, not a box of roles. Also the 19 kinds of firm with their firm counts. Use search_jobs list=<slug> for a list's roles and save_list to keep one; when the member is signed in, `saved` says which they keep.
name: browse_lists
title: Ready-made lists
